Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for SGPGIMS Junior Resident Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for SGPGIMS Junior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Junior Resident (Non-Academic) posts at SGPGIMS is scheduled for 25 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Resident (Non-Academic) position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Junior Resident (Non-Academic) post at SGPGIMS. These vacancies are specifically for the Hospital Administration department.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for the SGPGIMS Junior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can attend the walk-in interview without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for this SGPGIMS recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is strictly Walk-in. Candidates need to appear in person at the designated venue on the interview date with all required documents.

faq.question: Q5. What are the eligibility criteria for the Junior Resident (Non-Academic) post?
faq.answer: The specific eligibility criteria, including educational qualifications, are not detailed here. Candidates are strongly advised to refer to the official notification for comprehensive details on eligibility.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the Junior Resident (Non-Academic) position?
faq.answer: The age limit details for the Junior Resident (Non-Academic) posts are not provided in this summary. Please consult the official SGPGIMS notification for information on age limits and any applicable relaxations.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable). Recent passport-size photographs are also required.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the SGPGIMS Junior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves two main stages: Document Verification and a Walk-in Interview. Candidates must successfully clear both stages to be considered for the position.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the SGPGIMS located?
faq.answer: SGPGIMS is located in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh. The specific venue for the walk-in interview will be mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a contractual job?
faq.answer: Yes, the Junior Resident (Non-Academic) positions at SGPGIMS are on a contractual basis. This is a key detail for candidates considering this opportunity.
